name: Chana chaat (chickpea salad with onion, tomato and chaat masala)

source.name: Hebbar's Kitchen (hebbarskitchen.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 2. Uses the boiled chickpea entry directly (recipe lists 2 cups soaked and boiled chana = 328 g), so no water is added and nothing is cooked off; cooked weight equals the ingredient sum. 1/2 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 1.3 g; 1/4 tsp cumin powder 0.5 g; 1 tsp green chutney taken as 5 g cilantro; 1/2 tsp chaat masala (not in catalog) split as 0.8 g cumin + 0.7 g salt; 2 tbsp tamarind chutney 40 g taken as USDA sweet chutney; 1/4 tsp salt 1.5 g; 2 tbsp onion 20 g; 2 tbsp tomato 22 g; 3 tbsp boiled potato 30 g; 2 tbsp cucumber 16 g; 1 green chili 5 g; 2 tbsp fine sev 12 g taken as USDA snack mix; 1 tbsp coriander 1 g.

ingredients.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt
Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt
